description: This file defines the PersistentStateFactory class, which creates instances of IPersistentState for grains in Orleans, along with the PersistentState class implementing state storage lifecycle management.

classes.name: PersistentStateFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating persistent state instances for grains.

classes.name: PersistentState`1
classes.description: Implements IPersistentState and ILifecycleObserver to manage state persistence and lifecycle events.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a persistent state instance for a given grain context and configuration.

methods.name: GetFullStateName
methods.description: Generates the full state name based on the grain context and configuration.

methods.name: ThrowMissingProviderException
methods.description: Throws an exception when no storage provider is found for the specified configuration.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Handles the startup event for the persistent state, loading state if necessary.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Handles the shutdown event for the persistent state (no specific logic).
